fact: The Council of Ministers of 28 April 2021 adopted, for the Ministry of the Interior and Security, a decree creating the national steering committee of the SIPAO programme and a decree creating the Centre de Traitement des Informations Policières (CTIP) and the Système d'Information Policière de Côte d'Ivoire (SIP CI), an electronic police information system to be used and shared by the justice system, the national police, the gendarmerie and other law-enforcement services, with files of judicial antecedents, wanted persons and reported or stolen weapons.
title: Communiqué du Conseil des ministres du mercredi 28 avril 2021
